name: security-health
description: security-health CLI surface. Schema-validated against cli-manifest/v1 and cross-validated against the Connect-RPC proto descriptors at test time. Loaded by cli/main.go via cliapp.LoadFromManifest.

groups.name: validate
groups.description: Validate a scenario's security posture (secrets, Go SAST, Go vuln-DB, JS deps)

commands.name: scenario
commands.description: Run the applicable security scanners against a scenario and report normalized findings

groups.name: fix
groups.description: Preview or apply deterministic security posture fixes

commands.name: preview
commands.description: Preview safe deterministic security fixes without writing files

flags.name: rule
flags.description: Restrict fixes to a rule id; repeat or comma-separate values

flags.name: rule
flags.description: Restrict fixes to a rule id; repeat or comma-separate values

groups.name: deps
groups.description: Query the fleet dependency & vulnerability intelligence index

commands.name: search
commands.description: Search dependencies across scenarios; answers 'who is exposed to CVE-X?'

positionals.name: query
positionals.description: Free-text query (optional when using only filters)

flags.name: mode
flags.description: Retrieval mode: ai | text (default lets the server choose)

flags.name: vulnerable-only
flags.description: Only return dependencies with known vulnerabilities

commands.name: status
commands.description: Report dependency-index availability, counts, and last reconcile

commands.name: vulnerabilities
commands.description: List structured vulnerability evidence across fleet dependencies

positionals.name: package
positionals.description: Optional package filter, such as react or golang.org/x/net

flags.name: vulnerability
flags.description: Filter by CVE, GHSA, GO, or OSV id

flags.name: minimum-confidence
flags.description: Minimum evidence confidence: degraded | advisory | gating

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain one vulnerability with affected scenarios and fixed-version guidance

positionals.name: vulnerability
positionals.description: CVE, GHSA, GO, or OSV id

groups.name: reindex
groups.description: Reconcile the fleet dependency corpus (re-walk lockfiles, re-annotate vulns)

commands.name: run
commands.description: Start a reindex job (or compute the plan with --dry-run)

flags.name: scenario
flags.description: Limit to a single scenario; empty means all

commands.name: cancel
commands.description: Request cooperative cancellation of an in-flight reindex job
